request: Source-only v8 fast-forward if safe, protect Vault HMAC checkout and all production containers; no restart.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
v=/home/admin1/projects/astera_v8
l=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault
echo 'VAULT_API_EXPORT_IN_HOST'
if git -C "$l" show HEAD:src/index.ts | grep -q 'export.*materializeRuntimeSecret'; then echo 'HOST_VAULT_DIRECT_EXPORT=YES'; else echo 'HOST_VAULT_DIRECT_EXPORT=NO'; fi
test "$(git -C "$v" branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git -C "$v" rev-parse HEAD)" = 9209aaedd8f0721df75a03a8060607da6ac3ac13
test -z "$(git -C "$v" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
git -C "$v" fetch --no-tags origin main
target=$(git -C "$v" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
test "$target" = 57dee0e189391c1f50b28aa5029fa2b264c7d651
git -C "$v" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$target"
git -C "$v" merge --ff-only "$target"
printf 'V8_HOST_SOURCE_SHA='; git -C "$v" rev-parse HEAD
echo 'VAULT_FEATURE_BRANCH_PRESERVED=YES'

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: V8 checkout main SHA 9209aa with untracked FETCH_HEAD,artifacts/ only; Vault checkout feature HMAC 4edc clean; main v8 CI SUCCESS merge 57dee; guarded ff-only source reflect, no deploy or Secret mutation.
